lastCompletedStory.title: Prove one story end to end through the headless seam against a real repo and a real remote

nextStoryContext: US-007 proves the headless seam (US-005) end to end against REAL git I/O: a real `git init --bare` remote plus a real scratch working clone in a tmpdir, one real `runSupervisor(opts)` call with `opts.headless = true`, and a REAL `headlessDispatchFn` closure wiring the production `openHeadlessDispatchLog` + `runHeadlessDispatch` (US-001/002/003) around a real spawned fixture child (`test/fixtures/headless/roundtrip-child.ts`, run via `bun`, never PATH-shadowed as a literal `claude`) that performs a real `git commit --allow-empty` + `git push origin HEAD:main` inside its own cwd (the scratch clone) and emits a real NDJSON `result` event with `total_cost_usd`. Everything ELSE `runSupervisor` needs (`readPrd`/`writePrd`/`readHandoff`/`reviewDispatch`/`writeSessionMarker`/`isPaneAlive`) stays the exact in-memory fake recipe `test/supervisor/headless-route.test.ts`'s `makeBaseOpts` already established -- this story is not re-proving PRD/review bookkeeping, only the headless dispatch's real git wire. New file `test/integration/headless-roundtrip.test.ts`: a shared `runRoundTrip()` helper re-run fresh in a `beforeEach` (so each of the 4 tests is independently satisfiable under a `bun test ... -t "<name>"` filter per this story's oracles), asserting (1) `status === 'complete'` + a captured dispatch uuid (whole-file oracle, AC1); (2) `commit reaches the bare remote` -- `git -C <bareRemoteDir> rev-parse refs/heads/main` + `git -C <bareRemoteDir> log -1 --format=%s <sha>` invoked directly against the BARE dir (never substituting a `git -C <scratchDir>` read for the bare-dir assertion itself, though the two shas ARE cross-checked against each other) (AC2); (3) `append-only log carries the result event` -- reads `headlessDispatchLogPath(claudeDir, uuid)` off disk and asserts a `result`-typed line with `total_cost_usd === 0.0789` (AC3); (4) `no tmux` -- the injected `spawn: SpawnFn` fake (the SAME fake shape `headless-route.test.ts`'s sibling 'tmux path unchanged' test proves DOES record `respawn-pane` calls when headless is off, making this a real proof-by-absence rather than a tautology) records zero calls (AC4). All 6154 pre-existing tests plus these 4 new ones stayed green (6154 -> 6158); no `check:all` ratchet needed raising (file-size/coverage/debt-markers/dead-code/dup all clean as-is). SCOPE HONESTY carried forward from this story's own `notes` (repeated here since the next story should not assume it was silently closed): the fixture stands in for the MODEL, so this story proves the SEAM plus the git wire and leaves UNPROVEN (a) one real `claude --print --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --verbose` dispatch and (b) before/after Anthropic console metering, the ORACULO CENTRAL the parent issue (CAM-516) actually names -- both remain an operator ceremony, not something to file as a same-branch issue (the CAM-162 add/add collision risk this story's own notes warned about). Next story per prd.json (US-008, priority 8) is a docs/oracle story about the `claude -p` prohibition, unrelated to the headless git-wire surface this story touched -- no shared implementation context to carry forward beyond the general headless patterns.md entries already accumulated across US-001..US-007.

No new external library surface introduced or re-touched at the API-shape level.
